text:
Jo Rivera: hey everyone! I'm Jo Rivera — joining today as Staff ML Ops. based in SF, WFH this morning but will be swinging by the office later. coffee nerd here (french press stan) and i play ukulele poorly. small Q: where's the french press kept in the office? also curious about badge pickup & lunch routines. :wave:

Kai Nakamura: welcome Jo! :tada: french press is in pantry cabinet B (next to the herbal teas). badge is usually at reception — if it's not there ping @people-ops. lunch crew hangs by the mural at 12:30 most days.

Zoe Martinez: yayyy welcome!! we have a tiny ukulele circle on Fridays at 4 — bring it if you want. :guitar:

Avery Grant: hi Jo — heads up the north elevator is on maintenance this week, easiest to use the side entrance or the stairs. there's also a drawer with coffee pods if you need a quick fix before the press warms up.

Sam Patel: welcome aboard! If you want a quick tour i'll meet you at reception at 2pm. also, what's your pastry preference? there's a bagel/croissant run at 9 usually.

Jo Rivera: thanks all!! pastry = croissant (hot take: flaky > everything). 2pm works for the mini tour. i'll DM people-ops about badge if it's not waiting. i'll also try to remember my uke. :sweat_smile:

HR-Bot: Welcome recorded for Jo Rivera. Action items: complete benefits enrollment by end of week and upload photo for badge here: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding.

Kai Nakamura: awesome — see you at 2 then. FYI there's also a #ukulele channel if you want silly tabs.

Zoe Martinez: caffeinated or decaf for the bagel run? we need intel. :face_with_monocle:

Jo Rivera: caffeinated please. and i'll bring a tiny uke to try not to embarrass myself. :)

Avery Grant: :wave: welcome again — excited to have you!
